test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91a81d9415abe705feeddd04a7440c03a9b99c6009142944e57a53c9700c42c0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

All the elements at the shift clockwise subsequently.

The bottom left corner element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c2943124cac7f4dcd98518886efacb1266c77f7ea1ebd3a794c647c7ab12e54.png] 

2) Second box series →

The top row elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ef6e341a2e4a8cb2d9d9d3faddfe0764fb118dd6f26d53df0406a29bcaf813e.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4eb3d6351379539371a339a6247da59db2ddf41b20914e138dc4d97b2996716.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
